purpose: Offline teardown contract for a separately authorized future opportunity; not an executable launch recipe

preconditions: current invocation and executable incarnation verified
client live and finish not already requested
sequence.after: Await actual client exit and both EOF under the original normal-close bound; retain any failure

preconditions: fixture live and stop not already requested
sequence.after: Await actual fixture exit and both EOF under its original bounds; retain any failure

fixture_format: Four lowercase ASCII letters stop followed by one LF. Not an empty line, JSON string, or literal backslash+n.
uncertain_write: Record an uncertain control write; do not resend it or reuse a closed/replaced PTY.
qualification: Exact bytes checked against the saved command owners only; no fixture or client launched
